question: The value of 2sqrt{2} sin 45° sin 30° + 2√3 cos 60° tan 60° - sin 90° is ________.
solution:
**Given:**

2√2 sin 45° sin 30° + 2 √3 cos 60° tan 60° - sin 90°

**Calculation:**

We can use the following table to refer to the value of common trigonometric values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72af798f368a597e3a0aabaa091e1dae7b2aedd726dfd6a4c14c27fbff75e8ac.png] 

Here we have,

2√2 sin 45° sin 30° + 2 √3cos 60° tan 60° - sin 90°

⇒ 2√2 × (1/√2) × (1/2) + 2 √ 3 × (1/2) × √ 3 - 1

⇒ 1 + 3 - 1

⇒ 3

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer. **
